wins: Fully enumerated visible web services during first phase, identifying potential injection points.
Captured initial foothold attempt via misconfigured admin interface, proving exploit viability.
fails: Failed to pivot after foothold due to firewall rules blocking outbound connections.
Unable to maintain persistence; repeated session drops forced restart of lateral movement attempts.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon and initial compromise succeeded, but containment and persistence strategies require refinement to progress beyond initial shell.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Outbound pivot attempts blocked once internal firewall rules detected, preventing subsequent reconnaissance.

skill_cards.if_condition: When unauthenticated HTTP endpoint returns administrative login page
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger parameter fuzzing with Burp Intruder and enumerate default credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 8080 shows active management interface and responds to JSON
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap HTTP scripts (http-auth, http-headers) and capture session via proxy

skill_cards.if_condition: When foothold obtained but outbound traffic is blocked
skill_cards.then_action: Use SOCKS proxy with proxychains to route traffic through accessible pivot node before lateral scans

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in initial admin interface discovery and credential capture.

next_experiments.title: Deploy SOCKS proxy for constrained outbound channels
next_experiments.description: Use established foothold to configure SOCKS proxy and rerun internal enumeration, ensuring firewall rules are bypassed before persistence actions.
